chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:

Do good and do not regard any part of it small because its small is big and its little is much. No one of you should say that another person is more deserving than I in doing good. Otherwise, by Allāh, it would really be so. There are people of good and evil. When you would leave either of the two, others will perform them.

key_terms.أَهْل: People/Those deserving or dedicated to something

ai.seo_question: Why should Muslims not neglect small good deeds?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) emphasizes the cumulative power of small deeds, a concept central to Shia ethical pedagogy, while warning against the psychological trap of 'complacency through delegation.' He illustrates that good and evil are self-perpetuating forces; by neglecting a duty, one effectively cedes it to those more inclined toward it, thereby accelerating the spread of either virtue or vice. This teaching underscores the individual responsibility to actively participate rather than passively assume others will fulfill the role.
